components.name: Primary Auth Action
components.description: Submits the current sign-in or account-creation form.
components.css: .ds-auth-primary { background: #005864; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 16px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-primary:hover, .ds-auth-primary:active { background: #004751; } .ds-auth-primary:focus-visible { border-color: #192D30; } .ds-auth-primary:disabled { background: #4C696D; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Authentication Field
components.description: A labeled email or password field with a distinct focus stroke.
components.html: <label class="ds-auth-label" for="email">Correo electrónico</label><input class="ds-auth-input" id="email" autocomplete="email" type="email" />
components.css: .ds-auth-label { display: block; color: #192D30; margin-bottom: 8px; font: 600 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #71868A; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #192D30; font: 400 16px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-input:focus-visible { border: 2px solid #005864; outline: none; }

components.name: Authentication Panel
components.description: The single bounded surface that contains the credential form.
components.html:
Inicia sesión

Ingresa tus datos para acceder a tus cuentas.
components.css: .ds-auth-panel { width: min(100%, 456px); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #D8E2DF; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #192D30; } .ds-auth-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 25px/32px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-panel p { color: #334A4E; font: 400 15px/22px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Auth Mode Selector
components.description: Two adjacent actions keep sign-in and account creation visible.
components.css: .ds-auth-modes { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: #EAF0EE; } .ds-auth-mode { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 8px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #334A4E; font: 600 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-mode-selected { background: #005864; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-auth-mode:focus-visible { border-color: #192D30; }

components.name: Password Visibility Control
components.description: Reveals or masks the password and changes its accessible label.
components.css: .ds-auth-password-toggle { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #005864; font: 600 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-auth-password-toggle:focus-visible { border-color: #192D30; }

narrative.overview: This entry screen serves someone reviewing money across currencies in a quiet home workspace with soft morning daylight. A near-white surface keeps the sign-in task familiar on a phone or laptop, while a restrained blue-teal accent identifies the brand and the next action. The documented scope is the authentication entry surface, not the rest of the app. It pairs a concise Lukitas wordmark and practical multi-currency explanation with a bounded form panel.
keyCharacteristics: Clear Spanish copy and visible field labels.
Calm, high-contrast neutrals with one blue-teal action color.
Familiar form controls, direct feedback, and a responsive two-column desktop composition.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep blue-teal attached to a meaningful action or current state; never use it as decoration across large surfaces.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use the platform's system sans-serif throughout this task surface; do not introduce a display font for a credential form.

rules.name: The Border-Only Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows to the auth panel; keep the existing border as its only edge treatment.

dos: Do keep sign-in and create-account modes visible together; the mode must determine the existing login or registration action.
Do keep the form readable at narrow widths and constrain its desktop width.
Do preserve the measured text and control contrast ratios documented above.
Do show loading, validation, authentication, duplicate-email, and connectivity feedback in neutral Spanish.
donts: Don't copy Rial's logo, QR code, visual assets, or exact interface.
Don't use accounting jargon, opaque currency conversions, cluttered screens, or decorative controls that obscure common actions.
Don't imply that Lukitas is a bank, custodian, or payment processor.
Don't default to generic fintech navy+cream+orange, gradients, QR codes, or decorative motion.
Don't expose unknown server messages, credentials, or implementation details in user-facing errors.
